Name: Spiral Mine Map Shortcuts
Author: JaneElliot
Description:
[b][size=4]Tired of running the spiral mines over and over again?  [/size][/b]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod adds four shortcuts to the spiral mine map (see the images for locations).  Should work on all mine levels that use the spiral mine map.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with any and all mods, unless they edit the mine maps (which almost no mods do).
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher version 2.4 or later
[*]Unzip the file and copy to your Mods folder
[/list]
Thank you to the Stardew Discord Modding group for support with Tiled, coding assistance, and all the ways that mine maps are tricky!  Please report any bugs. [b] Enjoy![/b][list]
[/list]
